notes.en: zai CLI packages built from one pinned source revision, with the natively built desktop app where available.
notes.zh-CN: 由同一份固定源代码修订版构建的 zai CLI 安装包，并在可用平台上附带原生构建的桌面应用。

notes.en: Release archives are published publicly while the application source stays private.
notes.zh-CN: 应用源代码保持私有，仅公开发布安装包。

notes.en: Every archive is unsigned; verify the SHA-256 shown on the download page.
notes.zh-CN: 所有压缩包均未签名；请核对下载页显示的 SHA-256 校验值。

installNotes.en: Unsigned build. Install with the one-line installer, which verifies this archive's SHA-256. To install manually, extract the whole archive and run 'python3 install.py' ('python install.py' on Windows) from the extracted folder. Python 3.10 or newer is required to install; install your coding-agent CLI separately before using it with zai. When the archive contains a desktop folder, 'zai gui' opens the bundled desktop app, which needs the platform WebView runtime.
installNotes.zh-CN: 未签名的构建。建议使用一行安装命令，它会校验该压缩包的 SHA-256。如需手动安装，请完整解压后在解压目录运行 “python3 install.py”（Windows 上为 “python install.py”）。安装需要 Python 3.10 及以上；请另行安装所需的编程代理 CLI。压缩包包含 desktop 目录时，可通过 “zai gui” 打开随附的桌面应用，该应用需要平台 WebView 运行时。
